refactor(comments): split comments_bloc.dart into three focused blocs (#4618)

* refactor(comments): split comments_bloc.dart into three focused blocs

Carve the 1,462-line CommentsBloc into three focused blocs composed via
MultiBlocProvider, with cross-bloc coordination going through
BlocListener-bridged outbox signals per rules/state_management.md:

- CommentsListBloc (497 lines): canonical commentsById store, load /
  paginate / sort / real-time stream / EOSE tracking, plus new
  store-mutation events (OptimisticCommentInserted/Confirmed/RolledBack,
  CommentReplacedInStore, CommentRemovedFromStore,
  CommentsRemovedByAuthorFromStore) received from the two other blocs'
  outbox signals.
- CommentComposerBloc (498 lines): main / reply / edit input state,
  two-tier mention search (restartable), publish + edit publish flows,
  emits ComposerOutbox{Insert,Confirm,Rollback}Placeholder /
  ReplaceComment for the UI to bridge into ListBloc.
- CommentReactionsBloc (388 lines): vote / vote-counts fetch / report /
  block / delete with droppable transformers; emits ReactionsOutbox
  {RemoveComment,RemoveByAuthor} for list cleanup after block + delete.

Pure-Dart helpers extracted to keep each bloc under the issue's 500-line
acceptance criterion: throttled_subscription.dart (token-bucket stream
listener), comments_list_helpers.dart (engagementScore + replyCounts),
mention_search.dart (two-tier helper returning records so the bloc owns
MentionSuggestion).

UI bridging lives in comments_screen.dart's _OutboxBridges, which also
re-dispatches CommentVoteCountsFetchRequested onto ReactionsBloc whenever
the loaded comment set changes (replaces the previous self-add inside
CommentsBloc._onLoadRequested).

#4478 cache-key fix preserved: rootAddressableId is injected into all
three blocs at construction; every postComment / deleteComment / loadComments
call asserts the rootAddressableId thread-through via verify(), and three
new outbox-emission tests guard the optimistic-placeholder reconciliation
including the relay-echo-arrives-first race.

Test surface: comments_bloc_test.dart (4,343 lines) split into three new
focused test files (113 tests total) plus updates to five widget test
files (comments_screen_test.dart, comments_list_test.dart,
comment_item_test.dart, comment_input_test.dart,
widgets/mention_overlay_test.dart) wired to the new MultiBlocProvider tree.

All 133 comment-related tests pass; flutter analyze lib test
integration_test reports no issues; dart format clean.

Closes #4516

* review: address self-review findings on PR #4618

Tightens the comments-bloc split after a deep critical re-review.

Correctness fixes
=================

- ComposerBloc: `droppable()` on `CommentSubmitted` + `CommentEditSubmitted`.
  A rapid second tap lands before the first handler emits the cleared input,
  so both reads of `state.mainInputText` would otherwise insert two
  placeholders and double-publish. Mirrors `CommentVoteToggled`'s precedent.
- ReactionsBloc.`_logFailure`: drop the overly broad `error is Exception`
  clause. Almost every Dart throw implements `Exception`, so the old
  classifier swallowed every Crashlytics report for vote / report / delete
  / counts-fetch paths. Now matrix-NO only for `LikesRepositoryException`
  and `CommentsRepositoryException`; block flow opts in to the broad path
  via a new `treatExceptionAsDomain: true` flag (mirroring the original
  `on Exception catch` semantics for blocklist failures).
- ListBloc: `_isInitialBackfillComplete` was a mutable instance var
  initialized to `true` — violates `rules/state_management.md` and could
  bump the new-comments pill for any pre-load `NewCommentReceived`. Lifted
  to `CommentsListState.isBackfillComplete` (default `false`) so it's
  observable in blocTests and survives state restoration.
- ListBloc: pagination cursor now uses the min `createdAt` across
  non-placeholder comments instead of `commentsSortedWith().lastWhere`.
  The old code returned the wrong comment under `oldest` /
  `topEngagement` sort and threw `StateError` if every comment was an
  optimistic placeholder.
- ListBloc: `CommentsListState.copyWith` aligns with the other two states
  — `error` is now sticky until explicitly cleared via `clearError: true`
  (instead of being silently nulled by every unrelated emit, which could
  drop a load-failed snackbar mid-flight).
- ComposerBloc: `clearActiveReply()` / `clearEditMode()` now correctly
  reset `mentionQuery` + `mentionSuggestions` + `activeMentions` +
  `activeMentionBindings`. Restoring pre-split behavior — the autocomplete
  overlay was sticking open after closing the reply input.
- ReactionsBloc: block flow now emits `ReactionsOutboxRemoveByAuthor`
  IMMEDIATELY after `blockUser` succeeds. A subsequent `toggleFollow`
  failure is best-effort logged but no longer rolls back the cleanup —
  the user "blocked" them; the list must reflect that whether or not the
  unfollow round-trip succeeded.
- ReactionsBloc: `_onVoteCountsFetchRequested` now `restartable()` AND
  merges into existing maps/sets instead of wholesale-replacing them.
  Combined with the new diff-only fetch in `_OutboxBridges`, fixes a
  steady-stream race where a slow earlier fetch clobbered fresher counts
  with stale values (visible as a count flicker 0→N→0).
- throttledListen: tears down the periodic refill `Timer` on stream
  `onError` (not just `onDone` / explicit cancel). Previously a transient
  relay error would leak the timer for the bloc lifetime.
- UI bridge: `CommentVoteCountsFetchRequested` now dispatched with the
  set DIFF (only newly-loaded ids) rather than the full id set, ending
  N+1 redundant batch fetches on viral videos.
- `_MainCommentInputState`: reply submit no longer publishes a NIP-22
  reply with `parentAuthorPubkey: null` when the parent comment has been
  removed from the store between reply-mode entry and submit. Cancels
  reply mode instead so the user re-targets a still-visible comment.

Test coverage restored / added
===============================

- New `outbox_bridges_test.dart` — 8 widget tests pumping the (now
  `@visibleForTesting`) `OutboxBridges` with mock blocs and verifying
  each composer / reactions outbox sub-type → correct list event +
  acked `OutboxConsumed`. Plus tests pinning the new diff-only +
  placeholder-filter behavior of the vote-counts dispatch.
- New `throttled_subscription_test.dart` — rate-limit bursts, refill
  after one second, cancel cleans up the periodic timer, and the new
  `onError` tear-down (`fakeAsync.periodicTimerCount == 0`).
- ComposerBloc tests gain explicit Insert → Confirm / Insert → Rollback
  outbox sequence assertions via `expect:` arrays (the existing
  `verify: state.outbox` only inspected the final value, so a refactor
  collapsing Insert into Confirm would have shipped uncaught).
- ComposerBloc tests gain the deleted "mention conversion on submit"
  group: canonical text + resolved pubkeys threaded into postComment,
  activeMentions cleared after success, raw-text publish on
  mention-resolution throw.
- ListBloc tests gain: loadMore `isLoadingMore` guard, `hasMoreContent`
  guard, #4595 regression (loadFailed → snackbar not stuck spinner),
  cursor-is-oldest-non-placeholder regardless of sort, no-cursor noop
  when all comments are placeholders, dedupe on inclusive `until`
  overlap, stopWatchingComments awaited in close, streamed comments
  after close don't throw (`isClosed` guard), EOSE backlog-vs-live
  pill bump distinction.

Polish
======

- Stale dartdoc / code-comment references to the deleted `CommentsBloc`
  fixed in: `video_interactions_event.dart`,
  `inline_comment_composer_cubit.dart`, `comment_input.dart`,
  `inline_comment_composer_bar.dart`, and
  `inline_comment_composer_bar_test.dart`.

Verification
============

- All three bloc files remain under 500 lines (492 / 495 / 441).
- `flutter test test/blocs/comments/ test/screens/comments/`:
  161/161 pass (was 133 — net +28 new tests).
- `flutter analyze lib test integration_test`: 0 issues.
- `dart format --set-exit-if-changed` on changed dirs: clean.

* test(comments-screen): pin surface size to insulate from test pollution

The Flutter test runner shares process state across files; an unrelated test
upstream can leave the binding's physical view in a tiny window (~140px),
cascading layout-overflow exceptions into every subsequent test in the same
shard. Pin our binding surface to 800x600 in setUp so comments_screen_test
isolates from that. Pre-existing main flake; my tests are victims, not
cause.

* review: address PR #4618 blocking review feedback

Addresses all 5 inline + summary points from @NotThatKindOfDrLiz's
review (https://github.com/divinevideo/divine-mobile/pull/4618#pullrequestreview-4342058456).

Newly fixed in this commit:

- **Mention search regression** (composer_bloc.dart:402): the
  `mentionCandidatePubkeysProvider` callback is now wired from
  `comments_screen.dart` to combine `CommentsListBloc.state.commentsById`
  authors + the existing following list. Restores the pre-split tier-1
  behavior of seeding mentions from active thread participants — users
  can again @-mention someone who already commented even if they don't
  follow them.
- **`comments_screen.dart` hardcoded English snackbar strings + unlinked
  `TODO(l10n)`**: added 10 ARB keys (`commentsErrorLoadFailed`,
  `commentsErrorNotAuthenticatedComment`, `commentsErrorPostCommentFailed`,
  `commentsErrorPostReplyFailed`, `commentsErrorEditFailed`,
  `commentsErrorNotAuthenticatedInteract`, `commentsErrorVoteFailed`,
  `commentsErrorReportFailed`, `commentsErrorBlockFailed`,
  `commentsErrorDeleteFailed`) with `@`-doc descriptions. Snackbar
  mappers now take `AppLocalizations` and resolve via `context.l10n.*`.
  Keys registered in `arb_consistency_test`'s `_knownUntranslatedDebt`
  set per the migration recipe in `rules/localization.md`.
- **`comments_screen_test.dart` bypassed `_OutboxBridges`**: the
  `_CommentsScreenTestContent` test helper now wraps its column in the
  real `OutboxBridges` widget so every test pumping the screen
  exercises the integration seam. Added a dedicated test group with
  two end-to-end bridge tests: composer's `InsertPlaceholder` outbox →
  `OptimisticCommentInserted` on the list bloc + `ComposerOutboxConsumed`
  ack; reactions' `RemoveByAuthor` outbox →
  `CommentsRemovedByAuthorFromStore` + `ReactionsOutboxConsumed` ack.
  `outbox_bridges_test.dart` remains for the standalone bridge unit
  tests; this just extends coverage into the production screen path.

Already addressed in the prior self-review commit `cdee731e9` (reviewer
saw the older SHA `85cbc6b60`):
- ReactionsBloc `_logFailure` `is Exception` → narrowed to named
  domain types only.
- `CommentsListState.copyWith` `error` clearing → aligned with the
  `clearError: true` flag pattern used by the other two blocs.
- 4 stale `[CommentsBloc]` dartdoc refs across the inline composer,
  video interactions, comment input, and inline composer bar.

Verification
============
- `flutter analyze lib test integration_test`: 0 issues.
- `flutter test test/screens/comments/ test/blocs/comments/ test/l10n/`:
  165/165 pass (was 163; +2 real-bridge integration tests).
- All three blocs still under 500 lines (495 / 492 / 441).
- ARB consistency test green (new keys gated by `_knownUntranslatedDebt`).

* fix(comments): close review cleanup gaps

* review: address PR #4618 strict-pass cleanup

Addresses mbradley's second-round CHANGES_REQUESTED review (l10n +
design-system + test-style debt in files this PR already touches).

Important (mbradley I1-I7):
- I1: `_ErrorState` now uses `commentsErrorLoadFailed` l10n key +
  `VineTheme.bodyMediumFont` instead of the hardcoded English snackbar
  text and raw `TextStyle(color:)` (`widgets/comments_list.dart`).
- I2: `_CommentsTitle` uses ICU plural via `commentsHeaderCount` (new
  ARB key) instead of manual `count == 1 ? 'Comment' : 'Comments'`.
  Adopts `VineTheme.titleMediumFont`.
- I3: `_CommentsSortToggle` toggles + semantic label come from
  `commentsSort{New,Top,Old,SemanticLabel}` (4 new ARB keys).
- I4: `comment_item.dart` reply + vote-toggle accessibility labels and
  the "Reply" button use 6 new ARB keys (`commentReply`,
  `commentReplySemanticLabel`, `commentUpvoteLabel`,
  `commentRemoveUpvoteLabel`, `commentDownvoteLabel`,
  `commentRemoveDownvoteLabel`).
- I5: dropped the three `// --- Title ---` section-divider comments
  from `comments_list_event.dart` + `comments_list_bloc.dart` per
  rules/code_style.md.
- I6: renamed all public mocks (`Mock*`) in the two comments-screen
  test files to `_Mock*` private form per rules/testing.md.
- I7: hardcoded English in test assertions now resolves through
  `lookupAppLocalizations(const Locale('en'))` for every flagged
  string. Wired the production-side strings through `context.l10n`
  in `comments_empty_state.dart`, `comments_header.dart`, and
  `comment_input.dart` (the test references force the production
  fix too). 6 additional ARB keys: `commentsInputHint(Edit)`,
  `commentsEmpty{Title,Subtitle}`, `commentsHeader{Title,CloseLabel}`.

Nits (mbradley N1-N9):
- N1: `_CommentsTitle` font replaced with `VineTheme.titleMediumFont`
  (dropped `GoogleFonts.bricolageGrotesque` + the unused import).
- N2: `comment_item.dart` body baseStyle now uses
  `VineTheme.bodyMediumFont`. Username styles kept as inline
  `TextStyle` — no VineTheme helper exists for Inter weight 800 14px;
  not in scope to add one + a strict-coverage test for this PR.
- N3: 3 raw `SvgPicture.asset(DivineIconName.*.assetPath)` callsites
  in `comment_item.dart` replaced with `DivineIcon(...)` wrapping the
  text-scaler-adjusted `size`. Dropped the now-unused
  `package:flutter_svg/svg.dart` import.
- N4: skipped — `Icons.schedule` / `Icons.local_fire_department` /
  `Icons.history` have no `DivineIconName` equivalents. Adding the
  SVG assets to `divine_ui` would expand scope beyond this PR.
- N5: `OutboxBridges._idSetsEqual` now takes the maps directly,
  short-circuits on `Map.length`, and walks `a.keys` calling
  `b.containsKey` rather than allocating two `Set`s on every emit.
- N6: documented in `_restoreOriginalCommentAfterFailedEdit` that
  the restored comment carries a new Nostr event id and therefore
  orphans pre-existing reply pointers — Nostr delete-then-repost
  constraint.
- N7: `_toSuggestion` in `CommentComposerBloc` is now `static`.
- N8: `CommentNode` is now `@immutable final class`.
- N9: dropped duplicate `// ABOUTME:` headers from the 15
  comments-bloc files (dartdoc on each declaration is the canonical
  description). Same treatment for `comments_header.dart` /
  `comments_empty_state.dart` rewritten in this commit.

Rebase + merge:
- Rebased onto fresh `origin/main`. Resolved ARB conflicts across all

  branch and the new `dmFormat*` / `welcomeRecoveryConfirm*` /

refactor(comments): split comments_bloc.dart into three focused blocs (#4618)

* refactor(comments): split comments_bloc.dart into three focused blocs

Carve the 1,462-line CommentsBloc into three focused blocs composed via
MultiBlocProvider, with cross-bloc coordination going through
BlocListener-bridged outbox signals per rules/state_management.md:

- CommentsListBloc (497 lines): canonical commentsById store, load /
  paginate / sort / real-time stream / EOSE tracking, plus new
  store-mutation events (OptimisticCommentInserted/Confirmed/RolledBack,
  CommentReplacedInStore, CommentRemovedFromStore,
  CommentsRemovedByAuthorFromStore) received from the two other blocs'
  outbox signals.
- CommentComposerBloc (498 lines): main / reply / edit input state,
  two-tier mention search (restartable), publish + edit publish flows,
  emits ComposerOutbox{Insert,Confirm,Rollback}Placeholder /
  ReplaceComment for the UI to bridge into ListBloc.
- CommentReactionsBloc (388 lines): vote / vote-counts fetch / report /
  block / delete with droppable transformers; emits ReactionsOutbox
  {RemoveComment,RemoveByAuthor} for list cleanup after block + delete.

Pure-Dart helpers extracted to keep each bloc under the issue's 500-line
acceptance criterion: throttled_subscription.dart (token-bucket stream
listener), comments_list_helpers.dart (engagementScore + replyCounts),
mention_search.dart (two-tier helper returning records so the bloc owns
MentionSuggestion).

UI bridging lives in comments_screen.dart's _OutboxBridges, which also
re-dispatches CommentVoteCountsFetchRequested onto ReactionsBloc whenever
the loaded comment set changes (replaces the previous self-add inside
CommentsBloc._onLoadRequested).

#4478 cache-key fix preserved: rootAddressableId is injected into all
three blocs at construction; every postComment / deleteComment / loadComments
call asserts the rootAddressableId thread-through via verify(), and three
new outbox-emission tests guard the optimistic-placeholder reconciliation
including the relay-echo-arrives-first race.

Test surface: comments_bloc_test.dart (4,343 lines) split into three new
focused test files (113 tests total) plus updates to five widget test
files (comments_screen_test.dart, comments_list_test.dart,
comment_item_test.dart, comment_input_test.dart,
widgets/mention_overlay_test.dart) wired to the new MultiBlocProvider tree.

All 133 comment-related tests pass; flutter analyze lib test
integration_test reports no issues; dart format clean.

Closes #4516

* review: address self-review findings on PR #4618

Tightens the comments-bloc split after a deep critical re-review.

Correctness fixes
=================

- ComposerBloc: `droppable()` on `CommentSubmitted` + `CommentEditSubmitted`.
  A rapid second tap lands before the first handler emits the cleared input,
  so both reads of `state.mainInputText` would otherwise insert two
  placeholders and double-publish. Mirrors `CommentVoteToggled`'s precedent.
- ReactionsBloc.`_logFailure`: drop the overly broad `error is Exception`
  clause. Almost every Dart throw implements `Exception`, so the old
  classifier swallowed every Crashlytics report for vote / report / delete
  / counts-fetch paths. Now matrix-NO only for `LikesRepositoryException`
  and `CommentsRepositoryException`; block flow opts in to the broad path
  via a new `treatExceptionAsDomain: true` flag (mirroring the original
  `on Exception catch` semantics for blocklist failures).
- ListBloc: `_isInitialBackfillComplete` was a mutable instance var
  initialized to `true` — violates `rules/state_management.md` and could
  bump the new-comments pill for any pre-load `NewCommentReceived`. Lifted
  to `CommentsListState.isBackfillComplete` (default `false`) so it's
  observable in blocTests and survives state restoration.
- ListBloc: pagination cursor now uses the min `createdAt` across
  non-placeholder comments instead of `commentsSortedWith().lastWhere`.
  The old code returned the wrong comment under `oldest` /
  `topEngagement` sort and threw `StateError` if every comment was an
  optimistic placeholder.
- ListBloc: `CommentsListState.copyWith` aligns with the other two states
  — `error` is now sticky until explicitly cleared via `clearError: true`
  (instead of being silently nulled by every unrelated emit, which could
  drop a load-failed snackbar mid-flight).
- ComposerBloc: `clearActiveReply()` / `clearEditMode()` now correctly
  reset `mentionQuery` + `mentionSuggestions` + `activeMentions` +
  `activeMentionBindings`. Restoring pre-split behavior — the autocomplete
  overlay was sticking open after closing the reply input.
- ReactionsBloc: block flow now emits `ReactionsOutboxRemoveByAuthor`
  IMMEDIATELY after `blockUser` succeeds. A subsequent `toggleFollow`
  failure is best-effort logged but no longer rolls back the cleanup —
  the user "blocked" them; the list must reflect that whether or not the
  unfollow round-trip succeeded.
- ReactionsBloc: `_onVoteCountsFetchRequested` now `restartable()` AND
  merges into existing maps/sets instead of wholesale-replacing them.
  Combined with the new diff-only fetch in `_OutboxBridges`, fixes a
  steady-stream race where a slow earlier fetch clobbered fresher counts
  with stale values (visible as a count flicker 0→N→0).
- throttledListen: tears down the periodic refill `Timer` on stream
  `onError` (not just `onDone` / explicit cancel). Previously a transient
  relay error would leak the timer for the bloc lifetime.
- UI bridge: `CommentVoteCountsFetchRequested` now dispatched with the
  set DIFF (only newly-loaded ids) rather than the full id set, ending
  N+1 redundant batch fetches on viral videos.
- `_MainCommentInputState`: reply submit no longer publishes a NIP-22
  reply with `parentAuthorPubkey: null` when the parent comment has been
  removed from the store between reply-mode entry and submit. Cancels
  reply mode instead so the user re-targets a still-visible comment.

Test coverage restored / added
===============================

- New `outbox_bridges_test.dart` — 8 widget tests pumping the (now
  `@visibleForTesting`) `OutboxBridges` with mock blocs and verifying
  each composer / reactions outbox sub-type → correct list event +
  acked `OutboxConsumed`. Plus tests pinning the new diff-only +
  placeholder-filter behavior of the vote-counts dispatch.
- New `throttled_subscription_test.dart` — rate-limit bursts, refill
  after one second, cancel cleans up the periodic timer, and the new
  `onError` tear-down (`fakeAsync.periodicTimerCount == 0`).
- ComposerBloc tests gain explicit Insert → Confirm / Insert → Rollback
  outbox sequence assertions via `expect:` arrays (the existing
  `verify: state.outbox` only inspected the final value, so a refactor
  collapsing Insert into Confirm would have shipped uncaught).
- ComposerBloc tests gain the deleted "mention conversion on submit"
  group: canonical text + resolved pubkeys threaded into postComment,
  activeMentions cleared after success, raw-text publish on
  mention-resolution throw.
- ListBloc tests gain: loadMore `isLoadingMore` guard, `hasMoreContent`
  guard, #4595 regression (loadFailed → snackbar not stuck spinner),
  cursor-is-oldest-non-placeholder regardless of sort, no-cursor noop
  when all comments are placeholders, dedupe on inclusive `until`
  overlap, stopWatchingComments awaited in close, streamed comments
  after close don't throw (`isClosed` guard), EOSE backlog-vs-live
  pill bump distinction.

Polish
======

- Stale dartdoc / code-comment references to the deleted `CommentsBloc`
  fixed in: `video_interactions_event.dart`,
  `inline_comment_composer_cubit.dart`, `comment_input.dart`,
  `inline_comment_composer_bar.dart`, and
  `inline_comment_composer_bar_test.dart`.

Verification
============

- All three bloc files remain under 500 lines (492 / 495 / 441).
- `flutter test test/blocs/comments/ test/screens/comments/`:
  161/161 pass (was 133 — net +28 new tests).
- `flutter analyze lib test integration_test`: 0 issues.
- `dart format --set-exit-if-changed` on changed dirs: clean.

* test(comments-screen): pin surface size to insulate from test pollution

The Flutter test runner shares process state across files; an unrelated test
upstream can leave the binding's physical view in a tiny window (~140px),
cascading layout-overflow exceptions into every subsequent test in the same
shard. Pin our binding surface to 800x600 in setUp so comments_screen_test
isolates from that. Pre-existing main flake; my tests are victims, not
cause.

* review: address PR #4618 blocking review feedback

Addresses all 5 inline + summary points from @NotThatKindOfDrLiz's
review (https://github.com/divinevideo/divine-mobile/pull/4618#pullrequestreview-4342058456).

Newly fixed in this commit:

- **Mention search regression** (composer_bloc.dart:402): the
  `mentionCandidatePubkeysProvider` callback is now wired from
  `comments_screen.dart` to combine `CommentsListBloc.state.commentsById`
  authors + the existing following list. Restores the pre-split tier-1
  behavior of seeding mentions from active thread participants — users
  can again @-mention someone who already commented even if they don't
  follow them.
- **`comments_screen.dart` hardcoded English snackbar strings + unlinked
  `TODO(l10n)`**: added 10 ARB keys (`commentsErrorLoadFailed`,
  `commentsErrorNotAuthenticatedComment`, `commentsErrorPostCommentFailed`,
  `commentsErrorPostReplyFailed`, `commentsErrorEditFailed`,
  `commentsErrorNotAuthenticatedInteract`, `commentsErrorVoteFailed`,
  `commentsErrorReportFailed`, `commentsErrorBlockFailed`,
  `commentsErrorDeleteFailed`) with `@`-doc descriptions. Snackbar
  mappers now take `AppLocalizations` and resolve via `context.l10n.*`.
  Keys registered in `arb_consistency_test`'s `_knownUntranslatedDebt`
  set per the migration recipe in `rules/localization.md`.
- **`comments_screen_test.dart` bypassed `_OutboxBridges`**: the
  `_CommentsScreenTestContent` test helper now wraps its column in the
  real `OutboxBridges` widget so every test pumping the screen
  exercises the integration seam. Added a dedicated test group with
  two end-to-end bridge tests: composer's `InsertPlaceholder` outbox →
  `OptimisticCommentInserted` on the list bloc + `ComposerOutboxConsumed`
  ack; reactions' `RemoveByAuthor` outbox →
  `CommentsRemovedByAuthorFromStore` + `ReactionsOutboxConsumed` ack.
  `outbox_bridges_test.dart` remains for the standalone bridge unit
  tests; this just extends coverage into the production screen path.

Already addressed in the prior self-review commit `cdee731e9` (reviewer
saw the older SHA `85cbc6b60`):
- ReactionsBloc `_logFailure` `is Exception` → narrowed to named
  domain types only.
- `CommentsListState.copyWith` `error` clearing → aligned with the
  `clearError: true` flag pattern used by the other two blocs.
- 4 stale `[CommentsBloc]` dartdoc refs across the inline composer,
  video interactions, comment input, and inline composer bar.

Verification
============
- `flutter analyze lib test integration_test`: 0 issues.
- `flutter test test/screens/comments/ test/blocs/comments/ test/l10n/`:
  165/165 pass (was 163; +2 real-bridge integration tests).
- All three blocs still under 500 lines (495 / 492 / 441).
- ARB consistency test green (new keys gated by `_knownUntranslatedDebt`).

* fix(comments): close review cleanup gaps

* review: address PR #4618 strict-pass cleanup

Addresses mbradley's second-round CHANGES_REQUESTED review (l10n +
design-system + test-style debt in files this PR already touches).

Important (mbradley I1-I7):
- I1: `_ErrorState` now uses `commentsErrorLoadFailed` l10n key +
  `VineTheme.bodyMediumFont` instead of the hardcoded English snackbar
  text and raw `TextStyle(color:)` (`widgets/comments_list.dart`).
- I2: `_CommentsTitle` uses ICU plural via `commentsHeaderCount` (new
  ARB key) instead of manual `count == 1 ? 'Comment' : 'Comments'`.
  Adopts `VineTheme.titleMediumFont`.
- I3: `_CommentsSortToggle` toggles + semantic label come from
  `commentsSort{New,Top,Old,SemanticLabel}` (4 new ARB keys).
- I4: `comment_item.dart` reply + vote-toggle accessibility labels and
  the "Reply" button use 6 new ARB keys (`commentReply`,
  `commentReplySemanticLabel`, `commentUpvoteLabel`,
  `commentRemoveUpvoteLabel`, `commentDownvoteLabel`,
  `commentRemoveDownvoteLabel`).
- I5: dropped the three `// --- Title ---` section-divider comments
  from `comments_list_event.dart` + `comments_list_bloc.dart` per
  rules/code_style.md.
- I6: renamed all public mocks (`Mock*`) in the two comments-screen
  test files to `_Mock*` private form per rules/testing.md.
- I7: hardcoded English in test assertions now resolves through
  `lookupAppLocalizations(const Locale('en'))` for every flagged
  string. Wired the production-side strings through `context.l10n`
  in `comments_empty_state.dart`, `comments_header.dart`, and
  `comment_input.dart` (the test references force the production
  fix too). 6 additional ARB keys: `commentsInputHint(Edit)`,
  `commentsEmpty{Title,Subtitle}`, `commentsHeader{Title,CloseLabel}`.

Nits (mbradley N1-N9):
- N1: `_CommentsTitle` font replaced with `VineTheme.titleMediumFont`
  (dropped `GoogleFonts.bricolageGrotesque` + the unused import).
- N2: `comment_item.dart` body baseStyle now uses
  `VineTheme.bodyMediumFont`. Username styles kept as inline
  `TextStyle` — no VineTheme helper exists for Inter weight 800 14px;
  not in scope to add one + a strict-coverage test for this PR.
- N3: 3 raw `SvgPicture.asset(DivineIconName.*.assetPath)` callsites
  in `comment_item.dart` replaced with `DivineIcon(...)` wrapping the
  text-scaler-adjusted `size`. Dropped the now-unused
  `package:flutter_svg/svg.dart` import.
- N4: skipped — `Icons.schedule` / `Icons.local_fire_department` /
  `Icons.history` have no `DivineIconName` equivalents. Adding the
  SVG assets to `divine_ui` would expand scope beyond this PR.
- N5: `OutboxBridges._idSetsEqual` now takes the maps directly,
  short-circuits on `Map.length`, and walks `a.keys` calling
  `b.containsKey` rather than allocating two `Set`s on every emit.
- N6: documented in `_restoreOriginalCommentAfterFailedEdit` that
  the restored comment carries a new Nostr event id and therefore
  orphans pre-existing reply pointers — Nostr delete-then-repost
  constraint.
- N7: `_toSuggestion` in `CommentComposerBloc` is now `static`.
- N8: `CommentNode` is now `@immutable final class`.
- N9: dropped duplicate `// ABOUTME:` headers from the 15
  comments-bloc files (dartdoc on each declaration is the canonical
  description). Same treatment for `comments_header.dart` /
  `comments_empty_state.dart` rewritten in this commit.

Rebase + merge:
- Rebased onto fresh `origin/main`. Resolved ARB conflicts across all
  17 locales by accepting both the existing English keys from this
  branch and the new `dmFormat*` / `welcomeRecoveryConfirm*` /
  `moderationToggle*` keys from origin/main. Regenerated
  `app_localizations*.dart` via `flutter gen-l10n`.

- `flutter test test/blocs/comments/ test/screens/comments/

- `flutter analyze lib test integration_test` — 0 issues.
- `dart format --set-exit-if-changed` — clean.

feat(video-editor): add clip playback speed control (#4598)

* feat(video-editor): add clip playback speed control

- Add per-clip playback speed selector (0.25×–4×) via bottom sheet
- Show speed indicator on timeline clip strip
- Persist speed in DivineVideoClip model and render pipeline

Fix Android speed propagation bugs:
- Add ref.listen for playbackSpeed changes so the native player is
  notified when the user adjusts a clip's speed (was never called)
- Extend _clipsChanged() to detect speed-only changes so history
  restore correctly picks up speed edits
- Apply speed and volume on MEDIA_ITEM_TRANSITION_REASON_REPEAT so
  all clips keep their per-clip speed on every subsequent loop
  (previously only REASON_AUTO was handled, causing all clips to
  revert to the speed of the last clip after the first loop)

* feat(video-editor): enhance clip playback speed handling and timeline synchronization

* refactor(video-editor): improve comment clarity for initial playback speed application

* feat(video-editor): ensure consistent playback speed across clip changes

* feat(video-editor): add discrete divisions for clip speed slider

* feat(video-editor): add localization for clip speed controls in multiple languages

* feat(video-editor): update clip speed handling and add widget tests for speed sheet

* fix(video-editor): use playback-time offsets end-to-end for per-clip speed

Addresses review comments on PR #4598:

- video_editor_canvas.dart: _consumeTrimEndStartPosition now accumulates
  precedingDuration with playbackDuration and converts the relative
  source-time offset to playback time, so post-trim seek lands on the
  correct global frame when earlier clips have non-1.0x speed.

- timeline_clip_controls.dart: split path accumulates clipStart with
  playbackDuration and converts the playhead's local playback-time
  position back to source time before handing off to the split service.
  Also clamps the speed picker so the composition cannot exceed the
  render cap.

- linux_video_player_backend.dart: _clipDurations is now stored in
  playback time, with new _sourceToPlayback / _playbackToSource helpers
  used by seekTo and _refreshState so scrubbing, total duration, and
  reported position stay consistent across speeds.

* fix(video-player): preserve runtime playback speed across implicit clip transitions

Two related fixes in the Linux backend that surfaced together as a failing
test on the playback-time refactor:

1. setPlaybackSpeed no longer overwrites the cached per-clip authored
   speeds in _clipSpeeds. Mutating them retroactively broke the
   playback-time <-> source-time mapping used by seekTo, producing wrong
   source positions on subsequent seeks after a runtime speed change.

2. The playlist-stream listener only re-applies the destination clip's
   authored rate on a transition when at least one clip was authored
   with a non-default speed. When all clips default to 1.0x, an explicit
   setPlaybackSpeed override is now preserved across implicit playlist
   events instead of being clobbered back to 1.0.

* fix: ensure thumbnail generation works correctly

* fix(video-editor): simplify test clip creation by removing default seconds parameter

* feat(video-editor): add tests for playback speed handling in video clips

* fix(video-editor): align playback-time invariants

---------

Co-authored-by: Liz Sweigart <127434495+NotThatKindOfDrLiz@users.noreply.github.com>

feat(dm): basic markdown formatting support (bold, italic, etc.) (#4621) (#4631)

* feat(dm): add inline markdown parser + AST for chat formatting

Lays the foundation for #4621 (basic markdown in DMs). Adds a pure-Dart
inline parser that produces a sealed AST of bold / italic / strike /
inline-code / markdown-link nodes. Plain text segments stay PlainNodes
so the render layer can delegate them back into the existing
LinkifiedTextSpanBuilder — keeping the @mention / #hashtag / URL /
nostr-ref pipeline intact when those tokens sit inside a markdown run.

Italic uses a CommonMark left/right-flanking word-boundary rule so
snake_case identifiers stay literal. Recursion is capped at depth 8 and
all malformed input falls through as literal text — no throws on
unclosed delimiters, empty runs, or pathological nesting.

No render-side wiring yet; that comes in subsequent commits.

* feat(divine_ui): add VineTheme.codeFont() for inline code rendering

Chivo Mono 400 13/20/0.25 — sized to sit flush with bodyMediumFont so a
monospace run inside a DM message bubble doesn't shift the baseline.
Picks up the existing Chivo Mono font family already used by
captionPillFont. Test coverage mirrors the captionPillFont pair so the
strict-coverage gate on divine_ui stays green.

Preparing the next commit which renders inline `code` markdown spans in
DM bubbles (#4621).

* feat(dm): add MarkdownTextSpanBuilder for inline markdown rendering

Walks an InlineMarkdownNode AST and emits a flat List<InlineSpan> with
style merging across nesting (e.g. **_both_** -> w700 + italic). Plain
leaves are delegated to a caller-supplied buildPlainSpans closure so
the render layer can route them into LinkifiedTextSpanBuilder, keeping
@mentions / #hashtags / URLs / nostr refs tappable inside markdown
runs. Code spans paint a translucent background via TextStyle.background
to read on both sent and received bubble colors without needing a
WidgetSpan pill.

Wires through markdown.dart barrel. Next commit consumes this in
_MessageText (#4621).

* feat(dm): render inline markdown in message bubbles (#4621)

Swaps _MessageText to a ConsumerStatefulWidget that parses the message
body through InlineMarkdownParser and walks the resulting AST through
MarkdownTextSpanBuilder. Plain leaves are routed back into
LinkifiedTextSpanBuilder so URLs / @mentions / #hashtags / nostr refs
inside, e.g., a **bold** run stay tappable. Sent / received bubble
contrast is preserved by a translucent-white code background that
reads on both primaryAccessible and surfaceContainer.

Bumps codeFont's weight to 300 (Chivo Mono Light) to use the variant
already bundled — keeps tests deterministic without needing the
allowRuntimeFetching=false gate to relax. Updates the strict-coverage
codeFont test to match.

All 89 existing conversation widget tests pass unchanged; markdown
parsing is a no-op for messages without delimiters, so plain DMs
render identically to before. Render-side test coverage for the new
markdown paths comes in step 7.

* feat(dm): add l10n keys for markdown formatting actions

Four new keys land in app_en.arb for the DM compose-side selection
toolbar (#4621): dmFormatBold, dmFormatItalic, dmFormatStrikethrough,
dmFormatCode. Each carries an @ description telling translators which
markdown delimiter the button wraps the selection with.

Generated files refreshed via `flutter gen-l10n`. The four keys are
added to test/l10n/arb_consistency_test.dart's _knownUntranslatedDebt
set so the 17-locale consistency gate stays green until the next
translation pass picks the short labels up.

* feat(dm): add markdown formatting actions to compose selection toolbar (#4621)

When the user has a non-empty selection in the DM composer, the text
selection context menu now prepends Bold / Italic / Strikethrough /
Code buttons before the platform's default cut / copy / paste / select
all. Each action wraps the selection with the matching markdown
delimiter (**, _, ~~, `) — or, if the selection is already surrounded
by that delimiter, unwraps it. State changes go through
EditableTextState.userUpdateTextEditingValue so the platform undo /
redo stack tracks the edit, and the toolbar dismisses itself after the
wrap.

Eight new tests cover: collapsed selection hides formatting items;
non-collapsed selection prepends the four in stable order; each
delimiter wraps correctly; Bold on already-bold text unwraps; labels
resolve from l10n (not hardcoded English) so the test breaks loudly if
the widget stops reading from context.l10n.

* test(dm): cover markdown rendering on message bubbles (#4621)

Eight new tests assert the rendered span tree:
- bold span gets FontWeight.w700
- italic span gets FontStyle.italic
- strikethrough span gets TextDecoration.lineThrough
- inline code uses Chivo Mono with a painted background
- received bubble paints a lighter code background than sent
- snake_case identifiers stay literal (italic word-boundary rule)
- unmatched ** does not crash and renders as literal text
- markdown-free messages render exactly as before

Test-internal helpers walk the RichText span trees to inspect style
flags, avoiding any dependency on golden snapshots.

* fix(dm): push search route on @mention tap so back returns to chat

Tapping a `@username` mention in a DM message bubble called
`context.go` and replaced the entire navigation stack, leaving the
user stranded on the search page with no way back to the conversation.
The sibling helpers in the same file (`_navigateToHashtag`,
`_navigateToProfile`, `_navigateToVideo`) all push — switch search to
match so the DM stays under the search page and back works.

* fix(dm): localize markdown toolbar labels

---------

feat(dm): basic markdown formatting support (bold, italic, etc.) (#4621) (#4631)

* feat(dm): add inline markdown parser + AST for chat formatting

Lays the foundation for #4621 (basic markdown in DMs). Adds a pure-Dart
inline parser that produces a sealed AST of bold / italic / strike /
inline-code / markdown-link nodes. Plain text segments stay PlainNodes
so the render layer can delegate them back into the existing
LinkifiedTextSpanBuilder — keeping the @mention / #hashtag / URL /
nostr-ref pipeline intact when those tokens sit inside a markdown run.

Italic uses a CommonMark left/right-flanking word-boundary rule so
snake_case identifiers stay literal. Recursion is capped at depth 8 and
all malformed input falls through as literal text — no throws on
unclosed delimiters, empty runs, or pathological nesting.

No render-side wiring yet; that comes in subsequent commits.

* feat(divine_ui): add VineTheme.codeFont() for inline code rendering

Chivo Mono 400 13/20/0.25 — sized to sit flush with bodyMediumFont so a
monospace run inside a DM message bubble doesn't shift the baseline.
Picks up the existing Chivo Mono font family already used by
captionPillFont. Test coverage mirrors the captionPillFont pair so the
strict-coverage gate on divine_ui stays green.

Preparing the next commit which renders inline `code` markdown spans in
DM bubbles (#4621).

* feat(dm): add MarkdownTextSpanBuilder for inline markdown rendering

Walks an InlineMarkdownNode AST and emits a flat List<InlineSpan> with
style merging across nesting (e.g. **_both_** -> w700 + italic). Plain
leaves are delegated to a caller-supplied buildPlainSpans closure so
the render layer can route them into LinkifiedTextSpanBuilder, keeping
@mentions / #hashtags / URLs / nostr refs tappable inside markdown
runs. Code spans paint a translucent background via TextStyle.background
to read on both sent and received bubble colors without needing a
WidgetSpan pill.

Wires through markdown.dart barrel. Next commit consumes this in
_MessageText (#4621).

* feat(dm): render inline markdown in message bubbles (#4621)

Swaps _MessageText to a ConsumerStatefulWidget that parses the message
body through InlineMarkdownParser and walks the resulting AST through
MarkdownTextSpanBuilder. Plain leaves are routed back into
LinkifiedTextSpanBuilder so URLs / @mentions / #hashtags / nostr refs
inside, e.g., a **bold** run stay tappable. Sent / received bubble
contrast is preserved by a translucent-white code background that
reads on both primaryAccessible and surfaceContainer.

Bumps codeFont's weight to 300 (Chivo Mono Light) to use the variant
already bundled — keeps tests deterministic without needing the
allowRuntimeFetching=false gate to relax. Updates the strict-coverage
codeFont test to match.

All 89 existing conversation widget tests pass unchanged; markdown
parsing is a no-op for messages without delimiters, so plain DMs
render identically to before. Render-side test coverage for the new
markdown paths comes in step 7.

* feat(dm): add l10n keys for markdown formatting actions

Four new keys land in app_en.arb for the DM compose-side selection
toolbar (#4621): dmFormatBold, dmFormatItalic, dmFormatStrikethrough,
dmFormatCode. Each carries an @ description telling translators which
markdown delimiter the button wraps the selection with.

Generated files refreshed via `flutter gen-l10n`. The four keys are
added to test/l10n/arb_consistency_test.dart's _knownUntranslatedDebt
set so the 17-locale consistency gate stays green until the next
translation pass picks the short labels up.

* feat(dm): add markdown formatting actions to compose selection toolbar (#4621)

When the user has a non-empty selection in the DM composer, the text
selection context menu now prepends Bold / Italic / Strikethrough /
Code buttons before the platform's default cut / copy / paste / select
all. Each action wraps the selection with the matching markdown
delimiter (**, _, ~~, `) — or, if the selection is already surrounded
by that delimiter, unwraps it. State changes go through
EditableTextState.userUpdateTextEditingValue so the platform undo /
redo stack tracks the edit, and the toolbar dismisses itself after the
wrap.

Eight new tests cover: collapsed selection hides formatting items;
non-collapsed selection prepends the four in stable order; each
delimiter wraps correctly; Bold on already-bold text unwraps; labels
resolve from l10n (not hardcoded English) so the test breaks loudly if
the widget stops reading from context.l10n.

* test(dm): cover markdown rendering on message bubbles (#4621)

Eight new tests assert the rendered span tree:
- bold span gets FontWeight.w700
- italic span gets FontStyle.italic
- strikethrough span gets TextDecoration.lineThrough
- inline code uses Chivo Mono with a painted background
- received bubble paints a lighter code background than sent
- snake_case identifiers stay literal (italic word-boundary rule)
- unmatched ** does not crash and renders as literal text
- markdown-free messages render exactly as before

Test-internal helpers walk the RichText span trees to inspect style
flags, avoiding any dependency on golden snapshots.

* fix(dm): push search route on @mention tap so back returns to chat

Tapping a `@username` mention in a DM message bubble called
`context.go` and replaced the entire navigation stack, leaving the
user stranded on the search page with no way back to the conversation.
The sibling helpers in the same file (`_navigateToHashtag`,
`_navigateToProfile`, `_navigateToVideo`) all push — switch search to
match so the DM stays under the search page and back works.

* fix(dm): localize markdown toolbar labels
